text:
Ava: Quick kickoff — planning a 30m mini-demo + tiny benchmark for the OSS RefKit next Wed 11am PT. Aim: show a 5-min refapp build, 5-min perf story (latency/cost wins), then 15m Q&A. Need comms, social copy, and inbound routing plan.
Jon: Love it. Target audience = developer advocates + early-startup engineers. Keep demo focused: scaffold -> wire up model -> perf tip.
Priya: For leads: we should gate with a one-question form (company size). Map to HubSpot list + add utm_campaign. Who can draft the form field names?
Marco: For benchmark narrative: show baseline (vanilla run) vs applying Redwood Optimize presets: batching + prefix caching + int8 quant. Key metrics: p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and tokens/sec. Want a small table and a short chart.
Ava: OK. Tasks: Jon — social/email copy. Marco — 2-min benchmark script + numbers. Priya — registration form + routing. I'll own demo script and slides.
Jon: Draft social: "Join our 30m lab: Build a refapp with the Redwood RefKit and see how to cut inference costs by up to 3x — Wed 11am PT. Register: https://tiny.redwood/ignite-mini". Email subject options: "30m: Build + Optimize an OSS RefKit" or "Reduce inference cost in 30m — live lab". Thoughts?
Priya: Use a hidden field on the form: lead_source=mini-demo-2026 and utm_campaign=mini-demo-ignite. HubSpot mapping: listId=45721, lifecycleStage=lead, ownerRotation=sd-oss. Also add tag: "refkit_demo_2026".
Marco: Benchmark script snippet (will include in slides):
```bash
# baseline
python run_refapp.py --model gpt-small --batch 1 --quant none --iters 100
# optimized
python run_refapp.py --model gpt-small --batch 8 --quant int8 --cache-prefix true --iters 100
```
Report p95 and cost/1k tokens. I'll attach CSV after runs.
Ava: Nice. Can we include one short CTA code sample in the email body? e.g.:
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = cli.generate("summarize: \"short doc\"")
print(resp.text)
```
Keeps it tangible.
Jon: Social + LinkedIn drafts ready — will post to the internal calendar for approvals. Quick previews: tweet, thread, and one long-form LinkedIn post.
Priya: Routing specifics: send registrants to a nurture sequence (3 emails over 10 days). If user selects "Enterprise" on company size, tag as AE-inbound and add to SDR queue. Otherwise MQL drip. Also create automation: if attendee clicks "download benchmark" -> tag as hot.
Ava: Good. Also want a short benchmark narrative line for the landing page: "See how small infra tweaks can cut per-token cost while keeping latency in-check."
Marco: Recommend we record the demo + make a 5-min highlight reel for on-demand. That drives long-tail leads.
Jon: I'll seed Slack + our community Discord a day before, then 1-hour and 10-min reminders. Need final hero image — @design please sync.
Priya: I'll create HubSpot form and automation today and post mapping here when done. Can someone confirm the registration URL?
Ava: Using the short: https://tiny.redwood/ignite-mini (temp). Priya please swap with canonical once HubSpot publishes.
dev-bot: Reminder scheduled: webinar "Mini Demo: RefKit" on Wed 11:00 PT, 1 day and 1 hour before.
Ava: Final checklist: slides (Ava), benchmark CSV + chart (Marco), social + email copy (Jon), HubSpot form + routing (Priya), hero image (design). Ping here when each is done. :thumbsup:
